correctness.rationale: Reconstructed theta standard-cycle convention (maximum first, increasing maxima), literal fixed-point arrow conditions, and both structural counts. In class 1 largest fixed point f forces below-f word decreasing; reinsertion after b surviving greater letters has binomial factor with j formerly fixed singleton slots nonempty, and the rencontres series yields F12=z/q D(z/q) for q=1-z-z². In class 2 smallest fixed point f forces all greater letters into one descending cycle; T_{a,b}=sum_r C(a,r)d_{a-r} b^(rising r) equals L((t-1)^a t^b)/b!. The polynomial factorial-moment transform L(e^{zt}R)=L(R(t/(1-z)))/(1-z) reduces F23 to the same formal series; finite orders are not the proof. New independent exact integer summation of both expressions checked all n=1..16; source verify.py independently describes literal arrow brute checks to n=8, not executed as source code.
